philosophy: Every rule defined, every constraint modified, and every trade executed by the autonomous agent is logged publicly with full analytical rationale.

activeConstraints.name: Max Single Position Limit
activeConstraints.rationale: Strictly prevents idiosyncratic concentration risk in any single equity, preventing severe drawdown from single-stock negative surprises.

activeConstraints.name: Minimum Liquid Cash Reserve
activeConstraints.rationale: Guarantees liquid buying power ('dry powder') to capitalize on sudden macro pullbacks without forced selling of core assets.

activeConstraints.name: Automated Trailing Stop-Loss
activeConstraints.rationale: Automated downside protection that cuts capital losses during systemic breaks, removing emotional hold bias.

activeConstraints.name: Eligible Securities
activeConstraints.rationale: Explicitly prohibits illiquid micro-caps, penny stocks, leveraged tokens, and high-decay options to prioritize capital preservation.

activeConstraints.name: Maximum Sector Allocation
activeConstraints.rationale: Ensures systematic sector diversification across differing interest rate regimes and macroeconomic cycles.

activeConstraints.name: Slippage Ceiling
activeConstraints.rationale: Protects against bad execution fills during volatile market open or closing auction imbalances.
